title: L&G convenes new effort to combat under-saving, as research shows midlifers least engaged with their pensions
desc: The L&G commissioned study, conducted by Public First, draws on insight from more than 8,000 people, and finds that around 9 million UK people aged 25 to 54 are not currently on track for an adequate retirement, taking account of basic needs, current income, and housing costs. Of these, 5 million are aged between 40-54 years.
